rationale: Currently hardcodes /mnt/UBUNTU_8TB/ paths for data storage. Must be refactored to consume a centralized PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR variable or .env config to resolve path drift across the orchestration shard.

Depends on self.stitch.client returning a valid Redis/Valkey client instance. Needs explicit type validation and fallback handling to prevent AttributeError during state synchronization.
Must implement __init__() to properly instantiate and expose the Redis client, fulfilling the dependency contract expected by sync_state and other orchestration modules.
Bridges MCP tool calls to manager.emit(). Requires implementation of structured error responses (e.g., 400/404) when tool_name is unregistered or malformed.
Handles the emit() dispatch logic. Must include tool registry validation and graceful error propagation to prevent silent failures in the orchestration pipeline.
Manages VGPU allocations via in-memory dicts backed by Redis keys. Requires explicit TTL/key expiration logic to automatically reclaim resources from leaked or idle agents.
Handles session lifecycles and exports. Shares the same Redis-backed state pattern and requires aligned TTL enforcement to prevent stale session data from consuming cluster memory.
